label: Physical Restoration Station
description: Tools and materials used to structurally stabilize and visually complete fragmented fossils.

materials.label: Apoxie Sculpt
materials.function: A two-part putty used to fill large gaps. It hardens without shrinking.

materials.label: Reversible Pigments
materials.function: Paint used to tint the filler to match the bone, usually one shade lighter to distinguish it from the original.

game_mechanics.sculpting_mini_game: Player must use a spatula tool to smooth the putty into the correct anatomical shape. If the shape is wrong, the 'Scientific Accuracy' score drops.
